items.en: Switching to another course now keeps the open tab; turn this off in Settings → Preferences → Navigation.
items.zh: 切换课程时会保留当前标签页，可在“设置 → 偏好 → 导航”中关闭。

items.en: The Canvas tab can show pages, announcements, assignment descriptions and the syllabus in Canvas style, with a default display setting and a switch on the page.
items.zh: Canvas 页签可按 Canvas 样式显示页面、公告、作业说明和课程大纲，可设置默认显示方式，也可在页面上切换。

items.en: PDF previews scroll continuously through the whole document.
items.zh: PDF 预览可连续纵向滚动浏览整份文档。

items.en: A term's files page shows each course as a folder, with one upload button for the open course.
items.zh: 学期文件页改为按课程显示文件夹，进入课程后用同一个上传按钮上传。

items.en: The status bar no longer reports background tasks that finished together as failed.
items.zh: 多个后台任务先后完成时，状态栏不再误报为失败。

items.en: The Semestra icon now appears on browser tabs.
items.zh: 浏览器标签页现在会显示 Semestra 图标。

items.en: Grade breakdown details now appear below the chart instead of covering it, and the weight total warning is gone.
items.zh: 成绩构成的明细提示改为显示在图表下方，不再遮挡图表；去掉了权重合计提示条。
